description: Verify one S1000D data module: well-formedness, XML schema (XSD) validation against the user's own S1000D schemas (S1000D_SPEC_DIR), BREX checks along the brexDmRef chain, and reference resolution (dmRef, pmRef, ICN entities, internalRef, applicRefId). Returns a "verification" status (the same VerificationStatus that s1000d-reader-mcp embeds) plus the details of each step. Does NOT decide S1000D conformance.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for referenced data modules, publication modules, ICN files and BREX (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; BREX is also searched under S1000D_SPEC_DIR). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

maxSchemaErrors.description: Cap on XSD errors returned (default 100). The total count is always reported.

maxViolationsPerLayer.description: Cap on BREX violations returned per layer (default 200).

path.description: File path of the data module (or PM) to check.

skip.description: Steps to skip. Skipped steps are reported with state "not-run".

xml.description: The document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB).

name: verify_data_module
